name: clear
summary: clear the interactive console

name: audio
summary: list or play a headless local host sound effect

name: quit
summary: close the interactive controller application

name: config
usage: config get ui.app_title | config set ui.app_title VALUE
summary: inspect or update supported watched host settings

name: program-state
summary: inspect or set the host-owned Idle/Running application state

name: ports
summary: list serial ports with VID/PID

name: discover
usage: discover [mdns dns-sd ssdp upnp ws-discovery broadcast netbios]
summary: discover peer PCController hosts on the local network

name: port-process
summary: show the exact process currently holding the selected serial port

name: open
summary: open explicitly or auto-detect by HELLO

name: close
summary: close and pause auto-reconnect

name: reconnect
summary: resume authenticated auto-reconnect

name: hello
summary: query and verify device identity

name: status
summary: query complete measurements and I/O state

name: event
summary: wait for an immediate door/key/RF/macro/device event

name: voltage
summary: read supply and INA219 bus voltage

name: current
summary: read INA219 current

name: temp
summary: read temperatures and stable sensor identities

name: stream
summary: set STATUS stream period; zero disables

name: message
summary: deliver a bounded notification to capability-selected receivers

name: settings
usage: settings | settings decimals VOLTAGE CURRENT | settings export-live | settings color INDEX | settings motion always|closed|open|never | settings motion-break 1..255 | settings motion-exit-hold SECONDS | settings audio door|relay on|off | settings set FLAGS LIGHT ON OFF DISPLAY_OPEN DISPLAY_CLOSED STATUS OUTPUT_PERSISTENCE STREAM DEFAULT_PAGE SAVE_LAST STATUS_COLOR VOLTAGE_DECIMALS CURRENT_DECIMALS MOTION_EXIT_HOLD_SECONDS MOTION_BREAK_MS RELAY_RESTORE_MASK
summary: query or update the firmware-owned EEPROM settings

name: menu
usage: menu list|current|layout [reset|set MASK PAGE...]|show PAGE|hide PAGE|move PAGE RANK|order PAGE...|page PAGE|prev|next|dec|inc
summary: navigate stable page IDs or inspect/configure persistent menu layout

name: relay
usage: relay N on|off|toggle | relay side left|right stop|up|down | relay off | relay test [MS]
summary: control safe relay outputs and side motion

name: estop
summary: lock or release all effect, motion, relay, and PWM admission

name: pwm
usage: pwm get|off|set CHANNEL PERCENT|raw CHANNEL VALUE|configure CHANNEL TYPE CURVE [GAMMA] [ICON]
summary: control logical brightness through per-channel curves or exact raw PWM

name: rgb
usage: rgb R G B [BRIGHTNESS] | rgb effect list|play|wait|stop|status ...
summary: set status RGB color or stream a configured flash/breathe effect

name: strip
usage: strip config COUNT | frame RGBHEX | rainbow [COUNT [FPS]] | effect list | effect play NAME [COUNT [FPS]] | stop | status | pixel N R G B [BRIGHTNESS] | fill R G B [BRIGHTNESS] | clear
summary: stream exact RGB frames or a rolling rainbow to 1..100 addressable LEDs

name: buzzer
usage: buzzer FREQUENCY_HZ DURATION_MS | buzzer status | buzzer path board|host|both|none
summary: play a tone or select board/PC buzzer routing

name: melody
usage: melody list|create NAME NOTE...|delete NAME|play NAME [REPEATS]|wait NAME [REPEATS]|stop|status
summary: stream a reusable configured melody without filling the MCU queue

name: silent
summary: control independent board and host buzzer silence

name: display
summary: send arbitrary timed text; long segment messages marquee automatically

name: macro
usage: macro list|show NAME_OR_ID|create ID NAME [CATEGORY [COLOR]]|rename NAME_OR_ID NAME|category NAME_OR_ID CATEGORY|delete NAME_OR_ID|record start|start-mcu|start-board|import-board NAME [CATEGORY [COLOR]]|record status|record save|record discard|buffer clear|play NAME_OR_ID [host|mcu]|status|monitor|cancel [keep]
summary: compatibility name for recorded effects and timed sequences

name: effect
summary: discover, design, record, edit and run PCController-owned effects

name: os
usage: os status|facts [PROFILE|list]|policy|key KEY [HOLD_MS] | os virtual enable|disable|allow|deny [KEY] | os power ACTION CONFIRMATION | os power-policy enable|disable|allow|deny [ACTION] | os brightness get|set VALUE | os brightness-policy enable|disable|range MIN MAX
summary: inspect the PC or invoke explicitly policy-gated OS actions

name: automation
summary: list or manually run host JSON event-action rules

name: board-automation
usage: board-automation list | board-automation add EVENT EVENT_VALUE EVENT_MASK ACTION TARGET VALUE EXTRA [on|off] | board-automation edit ID EVENT EVENT_VALUE EVENT_MASK ACTION TARGET VALUE EXTRA [on|off] | board-automation remove ID | board-automation clear
summary: list or transactionally manage board-owned offline rules

name: rf
usage: rf send ... | learn [SEC] | cancel | list | remove ID|all | map ID ACTION ...
summary: send, learn, list, remove, and map 433 MHz controls

name: i2c
summary: scan or use the cooperative host-owned I2C bus

name: reset
summary: pulse DTR or request a device reset

name: query
summary: send a generic native request

name: opcode
summary: exchange an opaque versionless opcode (ACK expected by default)

name: write
summary: write raw serial bytes

name: board
usage: board initialize [--name NAME] [...] | board blank --confirm NAME [...] | board name [get|set NAME|clear]
summary: provision, securely blank, or name a board

name: driver
summary: inspect or repair the Windows USBasp driver

name: toolchain
summary: bootstrap or synchronize the firmware build/programming toolchain

name: boot
usage: boot probe|info|metadata|backup DIR|read FILE|write FILE|verify FILE|start [PORT]
summary: temporarily hand the UART to Urboot/Urclock, then reconnect the app

name: program
usage: program flash HEX [PORT] [--method urclock|usbasp] [--deployment production|development] [--reinitialize-eeprom] | program recover HEX [PORT] | program abandon TARGET_SHA256 ABANDON | program compile SKETCH [--firmware-feature NAME ...|--no-firmware-features] | program OPERATION METHOD PATH [PORT]
summary: guarded backup-then-flash, or non-write programmer diagnostics

name: host-menu
usage: host-menu list|directory|content NODE|set REF FIELD VALUE|add NODE ID LABEL TITLE [PARENT]|override STABLE LABEL TITLE [PARENT]|remove REF|open [ID]|status|key K1..K4 PHASE|refresh|close
summary: control HOST-owned front-panel menus

name: hotkeys
summary: inspect the active system-wide controller hotkey bindings

name: keyboard
summary: inspect or control the primary low-level PC keyboard hook

name: bridge
usage: bridge list | bridge call PEER METHOD [PARAMS_JSON]
summary: inspect or call authenticated remote controller hosts

name: peer-update
summary: transfer a verified host artifact and ask the peer coordinator to upgrade

name: webhook
usage: webhook status | pending [LIMIT] | dead [LIMIT] | replay DELIVERY_ID|all CONFIRM | clear dead DELIVERY_ID|all CONFIRM
summary: inspect and operate the durable outbound-webhook delivery queue
